name: Suzhou Garden (苏式园林)
use_for: Chinese classical gardens, Jiangnan gardens, 园林/亭台楼阁/曲桥回廊/山水园

proportions.layout: center pond (中心水池), buildings ring the water, winding paths between; NO axis symmetry except the main hall
proportions.storey_height: 3-4 for halls (厅), pavilions (亭) single-storey open

materials.primary_mix: white walls: 85% white_concrete / 15% smooth_quartz, mixed deterministically per-position
materials.secondary_use: columns, beams, railing, corridor structure, door/window frames (dark timber on white walls is the signature contrast)
materials.accent_use: rockery (假山/湖石: stacked stone with mossy mixing, irregular silhouette), stone lanterns, stepping stones

roof.type: hip (歇山) for halls and square pavilions, conical point (攒尖) for round/square small pavilions; flying eaves with upturned corners (飞檐翘角)
roof.slope: 45 degrees at ridge, softening to ~30 near eaves (举折 curve); corners upturn 1-2
roof.overhang: 1-2 (deeper than western roofs; eaves cast shadow band on white walls)
roof.material: deepslate_tile_stairs (黛瓦) — always dark grey, distinct from white walls
roof.pattern: patterns/hip_roof.py; upturn corners manually 1-2 at four corners

windows.pattern: lattice windows (漏窗): decorative openings in white garden walls, geometric pattern from dark fence/bars; hall windows are full-height dark timber lattice
windows.size: 1x2 or 2x2 for lattice, full bay for halls
windows.pattern_script: none — compose lattice manually per opening

details.moon_gate: circular opening in white wall (月洞门), diameter 4-5 (odd), white frame ring, leads between garden zones
details.pond: center water body, irregular shoreline (no circles/rectangles), depth 1-2, lily pads + sugar cane clusters at edges, gravel/sand bottom mixed
details.zigzag_bridge: spruce_planks deck width 2, 3 or 5 right-angle bends crossing the pond to the island pavilion, low dark railing
details.corridor: covered winding walkway (游廊) along wall or water: dark columns every 3-4, hip roof deepslate tiles, half-height white balustrade wall with dark cap
details.rockery: stacked stone mountain (假山) 3-6 high, stone+andesite+cobblestone+mossy mix, irregular overhangs, pine/spruce sapling on top, stone lantern at foot
details.planting: bamboo clusters (3-7) at wall corners, pine on rockery, banana leaf illusion (broad-leaf plants) near halls, plum/cherry accent tree near water, never lawns of flowers
details.paving: mixed pebble paths: gravel+stone+cobble+stone_bricks deterministic mix, width 3 (min), meandering (no straight runs > 7)
details.lighting: stone lanterns (石灯笼: stone base + dark cap + glowstone/sea_lantern inside) at EVERY path bend and pond corner; wall-top dark lamps every 6-8; lanterns on corridor column tops and bridge posts; interior lantern per room
details.railing: bridge and corridor railings are CONTINUOUS, never stub posts: dark_oak_fence run + dark_oak_slab cap on top, posts (log pillar) only every 3-4; corridor balustrade = half-height white wall + dark fence + slab cap
details.decoration_density: RICH, not sparse — Suzhou gardens are dense with small details: lantern at every turn, plants grouped at every corner, rail/cap on every edge, lattice windows on every white wall run; every edge and corner should carry one deliberate detail

pilaster.note: Chinese walls stay flat; depth comes from eaves shadow and dark timber frames

string_course.note: use dark timber beam lines at column tops instead
